subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should this Z.AI probe-header PR wait for live Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof, or may maintainers waive that proof gap because the source fix is narrow and the linked issue has live header evidence?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a code repair; it is whether source/test proof plus the reporter's live before-fix evidence is enough without maintainer-held Z.AI Coding Plan credentials, and which duplicate PR should become canonical.

options.title: Require Live Proof Or Waiver
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until a contributor or maintainer posts redacted live Coding Plan endpoint-detection output, or a maintainer explicitly waives that proof gap.

options.title: Accept Source/Test Proof
options.body: Treat the regression test plus the canonical issue's live 429-versus-200 evidence as sufficient and proceed with normal merge review.

options.title: Choose Another Candidate
options.body: Land a different narrow sibling PR for the same issue and close this PR as superseded only after that fix merges.

recommendation.title: Require Live Proof Or Waiver
recommendation.body: Keep this PR blocked until a contributor or maintainer posts redacted live Coding Plan endpoint-detection output, or a maintainer explicitly waives that proof gap.
